Title: Login with valid standard user
Preconditions: Login page open; valid account available
Steps: 1. Enter standard_user. 2. Enter secret_sauce. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: User is redirected to inventory; Products heading is visible.

Title: Login with locked-out user
Steps: 1. Enter locked_out_user. 2. Enter secret_sauce. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Login is blocked and locked-out error is displayed.

Title: Login with invalid password
Steps: 1. Enter standard_user. 2. Enter an incorrect password. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Authentication fails with a clear error; user remains on login page.

Title: Login with unknown username
Steps: 1. Enter unknown_user. 2. Enter secret_sauce. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Authentication fails with a clear error.

Title: Submit login with both fields empty
Steps: 1. Leave username and password blank. 2. Click Login.
Expected Result: Required username validation is displayed; no navigation occurs.

Title: Submit login with empty password
Steps: 1. Enter standard_user. 2. Leave password blank. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Required password validation is displayed.

Title: Password is masked
Steps: 1. Type secret_sauce in password field.
Expected Result: Password characters are masked.

Title: Login page layout at mobile viewport
Steps: 1. Open login page. 2. Inspect form and controls.
Expected Result: Controls remain visible, readable, and usable without unintended horizontal scrolling.

Title: Inventory displays products
Steps: 1. Inspect inventory page.
Expected Result: Product cards show product name, description, price, image, and action button.

Title: Sort products by name ascending
Steps: 1. Select Name (A to Z). 2. Read displayed product names.
Expected Result: Names are in ascending alphabetical order.

Title: Sort products by name descending
Steps: 1. Select Name (Z to A). 2. Read displayed product names.
Expected Result: Names are in descending alphabetical order.

Title: Sort products by price low to high
Steps: 1. Select Price (low to high).
Expected Result: Displayed prices are in ascending numeric order.

Title: Sort products by price high to low
Steps: 1. Select Price (high to low).
Expected Result: Displayed prices are in descending numeric order.

Title: Add one product to cart
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; inventory visible
Steps: 1. Click Add to cart for Sauce Labs Backpack.
Expected Result: Button changes to Remove and cart badge shows 1.

Title: Remove product from inventory
Steps: 1. Click Remove for the selected product.
Expected Result: Button changes to Add to cart and cart badge updates.

Title: Add multiple distinct products
Steps: 1. Add three different products.
Expected Result: Cart badge shows 3 and each selected item is retained.

Title: Open cart and verify contents
Preconditions: At least two known products added
Steps: 1. Click cart icon.
Expected Result: Cart lists exactly the selected products with correct names and prices.

Title: Continue shopping from cart
Steps: 1. Click Continue Shopping.
Expected Result: User returns to inventory and cart contents remain unchanged.

Title: Remove item from cart page
Preconditions: Cart contains at least one product
Steps: 1. Click Remove beside one item.
Expected Result: Only the selected item is removed; remaining items stay in cart.

Title: Checkout with empty cart
Steps: 1. Open cart. 2. Click Checkout if enabled.
Expected Result: Application prevents an invalid empty-order submission or clearly handles the empty cart.

Title: Checkout information page opens
Steps: 1. Click Checkout.
Expected Result: Checkout: Your Information page is displayed.

Title: Checkout with all fields populated
Steps: 1. Enter first name, last name, postal code. 2. Click Continue.
Expected Result: User proceeds to checkout overview.

Title: Checkout with missing first name
Steps: 1. Leave first name blank. 2. Fill remaining fields. 3. Click Continue.
Expected Result: Validation message identifies the missing first name; user does not proceed.

Title: Checkout with missing last name
Steps: 1. Fill first name and postal code only. 2. Click Continue.
Expected Result: Validation message identifies the missing last name.

Title: Checkout with missing postal code
Steps: 1. Fill first and last name only. 2. Click Continue.
Expected Result: Validation message identifies the missing postal code.

Title: Checkout overview matches cart
Steps: 1. Compare item names, quantities and prices with cart.
Expected Result: Overview accurately reflects selected cart items.

Title: Checkout subtotal and total calculation
Steps: 1. Sum displayed item prices. 2. Compare subtotal, tax and total.
Expected Result: Subtotal equals item sum; total equals subtotal plus displayed tax.

Title: Cancel checkout from information page
Steps: 1. Click Cancel.
Expected Result: User returns to cart without losing selected items.

Title: Complete order successfully
Preconditions: Checkout overview open with valid order
Steps: 1. Click Finish.
Expected Result: Confirmation page displays successful order message.

Title: Back navigation from checkout overview
Steps: 1. Click Back to cart.
Expected Result: User returns to cart and items remain present.
